Jane Doe
Frontend Lead
jane.doe@example.com · +1-555-002-0202 · Dublin, Ireland
Hybrid · Remote · EU Citizen · Notice period: 30 days
SUMMARY
Jane Doe is a Frontend Lead based in Dublin, Ireland with 10 years of experience across Financial Technology, Cloud
Software, and Digital Media. She holds a bachelor degree in Computer Science from Trinity College Dublin and
specializes in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Redux, HTML5/CSS3, Webpack, and Jest. Her background includes
leadership experience guiding frontend teams and mentoring junior developers.

JavaScript (10 years) · TypeScript (8 years) · React (7 years) · Vue.js (4 years) · Redux (6 years) ·
HTML5/CSS3 (10 years) · Webpack (6 years) · Jest (5 years)

Industry: Financial Technology
• Led frontend development using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, and Jest.
• Guided technical vision and mentored junior developers within Financial Technology.
Senior Frontend Engineer — Celtic Cloud Systems Jan 2018 – Feb 2021
Industry: Cloud Software
• Built interactive monitoring dashboards using TypeScript, Vue.js, Webpack, and HTML5/CSS3.
• Engineered web interface components for Cloud Software platforms.
Frontend Developer — Liffey Media Mar 2016 – Dec 2017
Industry: Digital Media
• Developed user interfaces for web applications utilizing JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, and Webpack.
• Created modern responsive layouts in the Digital Media sector.

Trinity College Dublin
